Use Case: A new patient registers for the OmniPal Patient Support Program after being prescribed Omnitrope by their healthcare professional.
Preconditions:
- Patient registration feature is available in the application
- The patient has collected their prescription and has access to the product barcode (last 4 digits)
- The email address to be used has not been previously registered
Instructions:
1. Navigate to the OmniPal landing page.
2. Click the "REGISTER" button.
3. On the Welcome step, enter the last 4 digits of the product barcode.
4. Check the confirmation checkbox "I confirm that I have been prescribed Omnitrope (somatropin)."
5. Click "Next" to proceed to Patient Details.
6. Enter patient details including first name, last name, NHI number, email address, mobile phone, and password.
7. Click "Next" to proceed to Guardian Details.
8. Optionally enter guardian details (first name, last name, email, mobile phone) or leave blank.
9. Click "Next" to proceed to Delivery step.
10. Enter the name of person collecting the delivery and contact number.
11. Enter delivery address details (unit number if applicable, street address, city, postcode).
12. Click "Next" to proceed to Terms step.
13. Read and accept the privacy consent, terms and conditions, and adverse event contact consent.
14. Click "Submit" to complete registration.
Pass Criteria:
- A success message appears: "Thank you for registering, your account is now active."
- The patient receives a confirmation email (check spam/junk folder if not in inbox).
- The patient can log in with the registered email and password.
- The patient record is created in the system.

Use Case: A patient attempts to register with an email address that is already registered in the system.
Preconditions:
- Patient registration feature is available in the application
- An existing user account already uses the email address that will be entered
- The patient has a valid product barcode
Instructions:
1. Navigate to the OmniPal landing page.
2. Click the "REGISTER" button.
3. On the Welcome step, enter the last 4 digits of a valid product barcode.
4. Check the confirmation checkbox "I confirm that I have been prescribed Omnitrope (somatropin)."
5. Click "Next" to proceed to Patient Details.
6. Enter patient details, using an email address that is already registered in the system.
7. Click "Next" to attempt to proceed to the next step.
Pass Criteria:
- A validation error message appears indicating the email address cannot be used to register for this program.
- The user is NOT advanced to the Guardian Details step.
- A new patient record is NOT created in the system.

Use Case: A patient attempts to register with an invalid product barcode.
Preconditions: - Patient registration feature is available in the application
Instructions:
1. Navigate to the OmniPal landing page.
2. Click the "REGISTER" button.
3. On the Welcome step, enter an invalid 4-digit barcode (e.g., "0000" or "9999").
4. Check the confirmation checkbox "I confirm that I have been prescribed Omnitrope (somatropin)."
5. Click "Next" to attempt to proceed.
Pass Criteria:
- An "Invalid barcode" error message is displayed.
- The user is NOT advanced to the Patient Details step.
- A patient record is NOT created in the system.

Use Case: A patient attempts to proceed with registration without confirming they have been prescribed Omnitrope.
Preconditions: - Patient registration feature is available in the application
Instructions:

2. Click the "REGISTER" button.
3. On the Welcome step, enter the last 4 digits of a valid product barcode.
4. Leave the confirmation checkbox unchecked.
5. Click "Next" to attempt to proceed.
Pass Criteria:
- A validation error message appears: "Please confirm to proceed."
- The user is NOT advanced to the Patient Details step.
- A patient record is NOT created in the system.

Use Case: A patient decides to cancel the registration process at any step.
Preconditions: - Patient registration feature is available in the application
Instructions:
1. Navigate to the OmniPal landing page.
2. Click the "REGISTER" button.
3. Begin filling out registration details (any step).
4. Click the "Cancel" button.
Pass Criteria:
- The user is redirected back to the landing page.

Use Case: A registered patient logs in to access the OmniPal Patient Support Program portal.
Preconditions:
- The patient has a registered account with valid credentials
- The patient is not currently logged in
Instructions:
1. Navigate to the OmniPal landing page.
2. Click the "LOGIN" button.
3. Enter the registered email address and password in the login form.
4. Submit the login form.
Pass Criteria:
- The patient is successfully authenticated.
- The patient is redirected to the Home dashboard.
- The Home dashboard displays the welcome message and available actions (Order SurePal Device, Schedule Training, Watch Video, Resources).

Use Case: A patient attempts to log in with incorrect credentials.
Preconditions:
- The patient has a registered account
- The patient is not currently logged in
Instructions:
1. Navigate to the OmniPal landing page.
2. Click the "LOGIN" button.
3. Enter an incorrect email address or password.
4. Submit the login form.
Pass Criteria:
- An error message is displayed indicating invalid credentials.
- The patient is NOT logged in.
- The patient remains on the login page.

Test Name: Patient forgot password - request reset link
Use Case: A patient requests a password reset link because they have forgotten their password.
Preconditions:
- The patient has a registered account
- The patient has access to their registered email address
Instructions:
1. Navigate to the OmniPal landing page.
2. Click the "Click here" link under "Forgot your password?"
3. Enter the registered email address in the form.
4. Click "Submit" to request the reset link.
Pass Criteria:
- A success message appears: "Your request to reset your password was processed. Please check your email inbox for the reset password link."
- A password reset email is sent to the registered email address.
- The "Back to login" button is displayed.

Test Name: Patient reset password - successful password reset
Use Case: A patient resets their password using the reset link received via email.
Preconditions:
- The patient has requested a password reset link
- The patient has access to the password reset email
- The reset link has not expired
Instructions:
1. Open the password reset email.
2. Click the password reset link in the email.
3. On the reset password page, enter a new password.
4. Confirm the new password.
5. Click "Submit" to reset the password.
Pass Criteria:
- A success message appears: "Your password reset attempt was successful."
- The patient can log in using the new password.
- The old password no longer works for login.

Use Case: A logged-in patient views the Home dashboard to see available program services.
Preconditions: - The patient is logged in to the OmniPal portal
Instructions:
1. Navigate to or confirm you are on the Home page after login.
2. Review the displayed content and available options.
Pass Criteria:
- The welcome message "Welcome to the OmniPal Patient Support Program" is displayed.
- The "Order SurePal® Device and Consumables" button is displayed and clickable.
- The "Schedule an Injection Training Session" button is displayed and clickable.
- The "Watch: How to Inject Video" section with a play button is displayed.
- The Resources section with links to SurePal guides (5mg, 10mg, 15mg) and Consumer Medicine Information is displayed.

Test Name: Patient order SurePal device and consumables - full options
Use Case: A patient orders a SurePal device and consumables (needle kit and/or pen replacement) for the first time or after 90 days from their last order.
Preconditions:
- The patient is logged in to the OmniPal portal
- The patient has not placed an order in the last 90 days, OR this is their first order
Instructions:
1. From the Home dashboard, click "Order SurePal® Device and Consumables".
2. On the Patient Details step, verify pre-populated patient information (first name, last name, NHI number, email, mobile).
3. Select Delivery Address Type (Place of business or Private address).
4. If Place of business, enter or verify the business name.
5. Enter or verify the delivery address (unit number, street address, city, postcode).
6. Click "Next" to proceed to Order Form.
7. Select ONE option from the Needle Kit Options (4mm, 5mm, or 8mm Needle Kit).
8. Alternatively, select ONE option from Pen Replacement (5mg, 10mg, or 15mg Pen).
9. Click "Submit" to place the order.
Pass Criteria:
- A success message appears: "Thank you, your order has been placed and will be delivered within 10 working days."
- The message includes information about pharmacy collection if applicable.
- Contact number for queries (0800 666 487) is displayed.
- The order is recorded in the system.

Test Name: Patient order pen only - within 90 days of last order
Use Case: A patient orders a pen replacement when their last order was placed within the last 90 days.
Preconditions:
- The patient is logged in to the OmniPal portal
- The patient has placed an order within the last 90 days
Instructions:
1. From the Home dashboard, click "Order SurePal® Device and Consumables".
2. On the Patient Details step, verify pre-populated patient information.
3. Enter or verify the delivery address.
4. Click "Next" to proceed to Order Form.
5. Observe that only Pen Replacement options are available (Needle Kit options are not shown).
6. Select a Pen Replacement option (5mg, 10mg, or 15mg Pen).
7. Click "Submit" to place the order.
Pass Criteria:
- Only Pen Replacement options are displayed on the Order Form step.
- Needle Kit options are NOT displayed.
- A success message appears confirming the order has been placed.
- The order is recorded in the system with only the pen replacement.

Test Name: Patient order - no product selected validation
Use Case: A patient attempts to submit an order without selecting any products.
Preconditions:
- The patient is logged in to the OmniPal portal
- The patient is on the Order Form step
Instructions:
1. From the Home dashboard, click "Order SurePal® Device and Consumables".
2. Complete the Patient Details step and click "Next".
3. On the Order Form step, do not select any Needle Kit or Pen Replacement option.
4. Click "Submit" to attempt to place the order.
Pass Criteria:
- A validation error message appears: "Please select one option."
- The order is NOT submitted.
- The user remains on the Order Form step.

Test Name: Patient schedule injection training - successful request
Use Case: A patient schedules an injection training session with a program administrator.
Preconditions:
- The patient is logged in to the OmniPal portal
- The patient has received their SurePal device
Instructions:
1. From the Home dashboard, click "Schedule an Injection Training Session".
2. Verify pre-populated patient details (first name, last name, NHI number, email, mobile).
3. Verify or enter guardian details if applicable.
4. In the Session Booking section, select a future date for the session.
5. Select a time for the session (at least 1 hour from now if today's date is selected).
6. Click "Submit Training Request".
Pass Criteria:
- A success message appears: "Thank you, your injection training request has been submitted."
- The message indicates the Program Administrator will contact the patient to confirm date and time.
- Contact number for queries (0800 666 487) is displayed.
- The training request is recorded in the system.

Test Name: Patient schedule training - past date validation
Use Case: A patient attempts to schedule an injection training session for a past date.
Preconditions: - The patient is logged in to the OmniPal portal
Instructions:
1. From the Home dashboard, click "Schedule an Injection Training Session".
2. Verify pre-populated patient details.
3. In the Session Booking section, attempt to select a date in the past.
4. Click "Submit Training Request".
Pass Criteria:
- Past dates are not selectable in the date picker (dates before today are disabled).
- If somehow a past date is entered, a validation error is displayed.
- The training request is NOT submitted.

Test Name: Patient schedule training - time validation for today
Use Case: A patient attempts to schedule an injection training session for today but with a time less than 1 hour from now.
Preconditions:
- The patient is logged in to the OmniPal portal
- Current time is at least 1 hour before midnight
Instructions:
1. From the Home dashboard, click "Schedule an Injection Training Session".
2. Verify pre-populated patient details.
3. In the Session Booking section, select today's date.
4. Select a time that is less than 1 hour from the current time.
5. Click "Submit Training Request".
Pass Criteria:
- A validation error is displayed indicating the session time must be at least 1 hour from now.
- The training request is NOT submitted.
- The user can correct the time and resubmit.

Use Case: A patient cancels the training scheduling process before submission.
Preconditions:

- The patient has started the training scheduling process
Instructions:
1. From the Home dashboard, click "Schedule an Injection Training Session".

Test Name: Patient order - change delivery address type
Use Case: A patient changes the delivery address type between business and private address during order placement.
Preconditions:
- The patient is logged in to the OmniPal portal
- The patient has started an order
Instructions:
1. From the Home dashboard, click "Order SurePal® Device and Consumables".
2. On the Patient Details step, note the current Delivery Address Type selection.
3. Change the selection from "Place of business" to "Private address" (or vice versa).
4. Observe the address form fields update.
5. Enter the appropriate address details.
6. Complete the order process.
Pass Criteria:
- When "Place of business" is selected, a business name field is displayed.
- When "Private address" is selected, the business name field is hidden or disabled.
- The address form refreshes when the address type is changed.
- Previously entered address details for the patient are pre-populated based on the selected type.
